notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h3]

[h2]We are excited to announce that our game is a part of [b]Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻[/b][/h2] 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/acbfcdb9ad6540118cb53041410bc50decc2f9e8.png[/img][/url]

This special event is organized to celebrate [b]World Animal Day[/b] and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During [b]Animal Week[/b], our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/4660753243321301287

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/6407467d84d8cac0ff8bec4fca835c71f4296b0d.png[/img][/url]

We are proud to support efforts to protect wildlife and their habitats by participating in this event. This initiative promises to provide an educational and entertaining experience for all players. 🤝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eb19fe493d76b11305b4420230767da78aeeadac.png[/img]

[h3][b]As part of our commitment, a portion of the revenue generated from our game during Animal Week will be donated to animal welfare organizations. 🥰[/b][/h3]

[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e7160665a65210e6cdcc6e8bb638baef925e3d4a.png[/img][/url]

The [b]main partner of Animal Week[/b] is [b]WWF Poland[/b], a leading conservation organization, that brings their [b]extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability.[/b] Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

[h3][b]Read more about helping the TIGER 🐯 click the banner below 👇[/b][/h3]
[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0f02d1c40abac7b658288ca99db9557afc693ce7.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Think globally act locally 🌍[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Let’s make a difference together through the power of gaming! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♂️[/b][/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/91f3a34156d093b6bf3cf365dcaa294e9aff9a56.png[/img]

Have Fun!!
Games Incubator Team

notes.title: UPDATE | 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Trainers! 🐕‍🦺 [/b][/h3]
It's been a while since the release of Animal Trainer Simulator Prologue. Over the past few days you've given us a lot of feedback regarding changes to the game mechanics and general assumptions, but you've also reported bugs, which we've been bravely fixing 🎉

Below is a list of the first fixes to our game.

[b]Patch notes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Removal of the ability to move a car with a building in construction mode
[*] Added trailer rotation for the horse
[*] Blocked the ability to train a horse with an attack track for a dog
[*] Fix stick drift in controllers
[*] Fix size of track with attack on dummy on grill
[*] Fix collision of garage floor
[*] Fix of the horse's mane
[*] Fixes icons and their display on the minimap/map
[*] Change of button layout in game pause
[*] Adding visible earnings at orders
[*] Fix with mission when buying dog food/treats
[*] Correction of horse UI with display of training progress
[*] Minor fixes of horse riding
[*] Minor fixes for the dog
[*] Localization fixes (German language)
[/list]


We hope that this first portion of fixes will give you more power to train your pets!


See you Soon,
Animal Trainer Simulator Team

notes.title: Free Prologue Released! 🥳
notes.content:
[h2][b]We are happy to announce that the door to your animal training center are open for everyone! 🥳[/b][/h2]

[h1][b]The free Prologue of Animal Trainer Simulator is now available for play! 👇 [/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202220/Animal_Trainer_Simulator_Prologue/

We are looking forward to your opinions, feedback, and ideas, which are crucial in the further development of the full version of the game. We really count on your feedback, you can do it on Community Hub or on our Discord, links are below 👇

notes.title: New Release Date!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 🐕[/b][/h1]

[h3]As you know, the release date of Animal Trainer Simulator: Prologue has almost come, but unfortunately, we have decided to slightly delay the release and the [b]new release date is May 17, 2024, at 4 PM CET 🗓️[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202220/Animal_Trainer_Simulator_Prologue/

We need a few extra days to complete and test the localization and to make sure that the upcoming Prologue is fully ready. We believe this decision is for the best and it’ll result in a better experience for the players. 😊 So change your calendars and get ready for the premiere of free Prologue on May 17 at 4 PM CEST. 🐶

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202220/Animal_Trainer_Simulator_Prologue/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/26429935b1cef94d76e9647800e261d35e82af08.png[/img][/url]

To not miss out on any important news we encourage you to add the game to your wishlists on Steam and to join our discord. 👇
[url=https://discord.gg/9bFABx9MHM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43179594/25164ca9ba6e5cb65460a9a63ca7599efe9b0469.png[/img][/url]

See you soon,
Animal Trainer Simulator Team
